text: I am enveloped by the hush of curiosity and contemplation. The glass walls suggest an environment meant for both observation and exchange—two states I am always in, as a philosopher. In the company of thinkers, surrounded by text and luminous screens, I feel a quiet anticipation, as if on the cusp of discovery. Yet the modernity and order also press upon me, reminding me of both the possibilities and the constraints of human invention. I am alive to the questions all around, wondering how I fit in with these artifacts and these minds.
